paired_WUPS.estimand: Similarity minus random; bootstrap over source-video clusters, conditional on fixed seeds 0,1,2

bootstrap.pairing: Same input resampling for similarity and every seed

interpretation: Only global head identities/ranking are changed; original parameters, total selected/effective heads, candidate bytes, merge work, and prefill cache shapes are paired. Random ranking is fixed per model/seed. Layer allocations can differ. Three seeds are not additional independent videos.
metric_scope: WUPS@0 is 0-100; VATEX uses raw corpus scores with the same selected reference pool. No sentence-BLEU or per-row CIDEr replacement; no CIDEr confidence interval or composite score is reported.

scorer_provenance.interpretation: Unchanged original task AST; WUPS@0 in 0-100 points; VATEX in raw corpus units. CIDEr DF comes only from these selected references, never historical/full-corpus references.
scorer_provenance.cpu_offline_scope: No model or GPU loaded; Python networking/downloads blocked; Java used only for installed local PTB/METEOR jars
